Subject: Follow-up + scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Hey John -

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get you a Dedicated capacity recommendation that hits your latency and throughput goals.

Recap of requirements you shared:
- Primary workload: real-time customer chat & routing (inference per user message)
- Expected steady-state: ~50-70 reqs/sec; peak bursts up to ~150 reqs/sec
- Average prompt + completion size: ~18-30 tokens in prompt, ~45-80 tokens in completion (~60 tokens avg)
- Concurrency target: support up to ~120 concurrent open sessions
- Latency SLO: 95p < 120ms, 99p ideally < 250ms (soft target)
- Model candidates: opt for a 13B quantized variant; open to testing a 70B distil if quality requires it

What I propose: a 30-45 minute dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your MLE and infra folks so we can:
- Validate throughput/concurrency assumptions and tail latency targets
- Review sample traffic and batching characteristics
- Share Redwood Dedicated sizing options (GPU types, instance counts, autoscaling/burst strategies)
- Agree on a mutual action plan + timeline for a POC

Available slots from my calendar (all PT):
- Tue 29 Jun, 10:00-10:45am
- Wed 30 Jun, 9:30-10:15am
- Wed 30 Jun, 1:00-1:45pm

If none of those work, send a couple slots that fit your MLE/infra team and we'll adjust. I'm attaching a brief mutual action plan and our dedicated architecture diagram so your team can review prior to the call.

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_FintechCo_v1.pdf, redwood-dedicated-architecture.png

Thanks - looking forward to aligning on sizing so we can give you accurate throughput and cost estimates.

--
